title: stakker
description: This simple mod lets you see what you got but without limits!
body:
Tired of counting how much items you got by stacks? Just download this mod!

With this mod you can see how many items you got in total or in stacks.

Also you can set tasks so you dont have to keep in mind how much stacks you need, mod will notify you when you reach your goal! and also show progress

This mod adds menu where you can see all your blocks in stacks (1.5 stacks for example) or in blocks (96 blocks for example)

Also it shows how many blocks you got in total when you are holding one

And it shows how many fireworks you got when you are flying
